scope: Two prespecified three-seed paired panels. Traditional installed LRU OPHOURS uses ChangesItemReliability.FRTCF; explicit position-A CALHOURS failure mode uses ChangesFailureModeReliability.FRQCF. Each control sets factor 1 at h9 and h24; each intervention sets factor 4 at h9 and 1 at h24.

manual.rule: FRTCF and FRQCF are positive factors applied to initial FRT/FRQ, keyed by IID or FMID and TIMEC. Traditional FRT changes apply only to primary items, while FRQ changes can target a position failure mode. The manual states changes immediately affect mission and preparation exposure.

frozen_delta: For each kind, duplicate the accepted D02 input, add only the matching Changes*Reliability table with h9 and h24 rows, and change the description and seed. Within each seed pair, only the h9 factor and description differ. No mission, stock, repair, initial FRT/FRQ, clock, result collection or horizon field differs within a pair.
acceptance_hypotheses: All twelve native inputs import, exactly roundtrip every authored populated cell, calculate and export usable event and report evidence with zero converter errors and classified warnings under guarded SSH0 execution.

For both kinds, the native evidence identifies the scheduled factor-1 or factor-4 change at h9 and common reset-to-1 at h24, or otherwise supplies an equally direct runtime indicator that the scheduled rows took effect.

At least one prespecified seed pair for each kind has a different physical failure history in the h9–24 factor window; all three paired outcomes for both kinds are retained and reconciled with report failure and repair bins. This is an observed fixed-seed contrast, not a probability or instantaneous-hazard estimate.
Native reports and events reconcile mission outcomes and terminal readiness for all twelve arms.
gate: Publish only if all twelve sources, guarded native closure, exact roundtrips, change-application evidence and independent event/report replay pass, and both item and failure-mode subpanels have a physical h9–24 contrast. Otherwise retain this candidate as a diagnostic and freeze a new version before further experiments.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, protected GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: Three fixed seeds per kind; traditional primary LRU OPHOURS and one explicit CALHOURS position failure mode only. No cumulative factor-law inference from event counts, unsupported target, other clocks, GUI, probability estimate or cross-engine claim.
